heading: side
name: 側邊標題組＋每列兩張文字卡片網格
desc: 左側約三成寬放標題組，按鈕橫跨整欄並落在左欄下方；右側是每列兩張、等寬等高的文字卡片網格。圖文左右可對調。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：標題組放在左側一欄，約佔三成寬度，其餘約六成多是右側的網格；兩欄的左右位置可以對調（標題組在右、網格在左），其他結構不變。標題組靠左對齊，包含大標題（可多行），下方可放副標與說明文字，沒有時省略；大標題明顯大於卡片標題。標題組最下方放一個按鈕，橫跨標題組那一欄的整欄寬，放在該欄下半部、接近網格的底部，和上方的說明文字之間留較大空白。網格每列兩個項目，項目等寬，同一列的兩個項目等高；每個項目是一張卡片，沒有圖片：上方是標題，標題後面帶一個小箭頭，下方是說明文字（可多行），文字靠左。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：標題組移到上方，大標題與副標置中，說明文字靠左；下方的網格改為每列一張卡片，直向排列；按鈕移到區塊最下方、所有卡片之後，橫跨頁面內容寬度。

en.name: Side heading group + two-per-row text card grid
en.desc: A heading group in a side column about three tenths wide, with a button spanning the column at its lower part; on the other side, a grid of equal-width, equal-height text cards, two per row. The two columns can be swapped left and right.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. It has two columns aligned to the page content width: the heading group is placed in a side column on the left, taking about three tenths of the width, and the remaining width (a little over six tenths) holds a grid on the right; the two columns may be swapped (heading group on the right, grid on the left) without changing anything else. The heading group is aligned left and contains a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a subheading and a description below; omit them when there is no content. The headline is clearly larger than the card titles. Place a button at the bottom of the heading group; it spans the full width of the side column and sits in the lower part of the column, near the bottom of the grid, with a fairly large space between it and the description above. The grid has two items per row; items are equal width, and the two items in a row are equal height. Each item is a card with no image: a title at the top followed by a small arrow, and a description below (may wrap to multiple lines), with the text aligned left.
en.mobile: Changes to a vertical stack: the heading group moves to the top, with the headline and subheading centered and the description aligned left; the grid below becomes one card per row, stacked vertically; the button moves to the very bottom of the section, after all the cards, spanning the page content width.
